definitions.reconstruction: All study dates may enter fit, including the scored date. Historical reconstruction, not as-known forecast. CL protocol preserved.
definitions.earlierOnly: Only cohort dates strictly earlier than the decision date; flag fewer than50 cases separately.
definitions.overnight: 50 closest numeric matches within same prior-BBOX bucket AND same previous-hour behavior. All five numeric inputs equally scaled at0.25.
definitions.ny: Own/Prior describes measuring range for Asia/London close. Exact selects one close-quarter; Wide selects adjacent exact historical quarters if current close lies within5pp of an internal quarter boundary. All matches, not nearest50.
definitions.normalization: Each historical U/D divided by its own frozen ten-complete-NY-session AVR, then mean/median multiplied by current AVR. This is not percent of price.
definitions.code: SPES1:15 fields matching SP5 numeric layout, with an ES-only marker; requires forthcoming ES indicator. Never paste into CL indicator.
definitions.captures: No daily chart screenshots have been generated in this stage.
